readout.summary: Maui Invitational opener at Lahaina (neutral site). Unbeaten No. 21 BYU (5-0) is favored over 4-0 Washington: BangTheBook lists BYU -10.5 and picks BYU on the moneyline (-535); ESPN gives BYU about 84% and KenPom projects a 9-point BYU win. Both teams shoot heavy volumes of threes.
readout.pick: BYU to win (BangTheBook ML pick at -535; ESPN 83.8-84%; KenPom). Spread BYU -10.5 (BangTheBook, Nov 22); no published spread pick found
readout.injuries: BYU: Robert Wright III (leading scorer, ~24 ppg point guard) day-to-day with a lower-body issue after missing the Nov 18 game; game-time decision per coach Kevin Young (Nov 22), no BYU update since (Provo.com). Dawson Baker will play Monday. Washington: none reported (Mady Traore available after knee issue, Ryan Beasley active, per RotoWire Nov 19-20)
